title: The Archive check sees the default branch's history, so it never tells a stale copy of an upstream archive to ship
description: The Archive check sees the default branch's history, so it never tells a stale copy of an upstream archive to ship
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cmd-change-029 says archive-readiness.sh, which the Archive check runs, SHALL NOT name change ship for a copy the remote default already archived; the Archive jobs checked out one commit, so the script could not see the default branch and still named ship (#965)
acceptance_criteria: the Archive jobs in ci.yml and trust.yml check out full history before the archive gate, and test-required-ci-gate.py fails when a job that runs the gate on the repository checks out a single commit; the archive gate script itself still never fetches
